notes.title: Canto I – 1st Anniversary!
notes.content:
[p]Dear Travelers,[/p][p]One year ago, [i]Canto I[/i] opened its gates to the [b]Dark Forest[/b]. [/p][p]Since then, thousands of you have double-jumped over spikes, dashed past specters, unlocked the hidden triplets of Dante’s verses and even braved the depths of [b]Hell Mode[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]We never imagined that this small passion project, inspired by [i]La Divina Commedia[/i], would reach so many of you around the world. Your reviews, videos and kind words have made this journey unforgettable <3[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110616/950de953bf130bb8be5d5b894707f99277ba5b44.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate the [b]1st Anniversary[/b]: We’re giving away 3 copies of our Dante's [b]Original Artbook DLC[/b] for free!
[/p][p]The first 3 people to email us a screenshot from [i]Canto I[/i] will win! (screenshots must be publicly visible here on Steam) :)[/p][p]... and don't forget to follow us here on Steam -> [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/neoclassicgames/"]Neoclassic Games[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your amazing support so far![/p]

notes.title: Canto I, full Controller Update!
notes.content:
Hiya everyone, LudosGD here!

First of all, thanks to everyone who played the game! It means a lot to me and I'm glad so many of you had fun with it.

Canto I 1.1 update is out NOW! It focuses on improving controller support, after collecting various feedback. Here are the changes:
[list]
[*]Fullscreen mode support. Fullscreen is now an option in the options menu. It can also be toggled by pressing F2.
[*]Controller support improvement! Fixed various controller-related bugs, such as:
[list]
[*]Bug preventing controller users to select voices on menus;
[*]Bug causing issues with movement and jump inputs after using the joystick.[/list]
[*]Removed the very unwieldy d-pad and joystick jump input.
[*]Move with d-pad or left joystick.
[*]Jump with Triangle or Cross (Playstation), A or Y (Xbox), B or X (Nintendo).
[*]Attack with Square or Circle (Playstation), X or B (Xbox), A or Y (Nintendo).
[*]Dash with L1 or R1.[/list]

I hope these changes will make your next adventure into the Forest Dark more comfortable!

Enjoy, and have a wonderful day! :D
— LudosGD
